main.description: Begin provisioning an etzhayyim ERC725 root identity. Returns a digest the caller must sign with their intended activeKey (EOA or smart-wallet-recovered P256 via WebAuthn) and submit to completeRootProvision. Per ADR-2605212030 §D4. Phase α: provisioning is Council-gated; the digest binds to a Council proposal nonce that only Council can finalize.

dwebHandle.description: Public handle of the form `<handle>.etzhayyim.com` — becomes the did:web facade for this root.

activeKey.description: 0x-prefixed 20-byte Ethereum address that will own the new root (EOA or Smart Wallet).

purposeNarrow.description: Optional human-readable purpose statement embedded in the digest for audit.

digest.description: 0x-prefixed 32-byte digest the caller must sign with `activeKey` (EIP-191 personal_sign).

dwebHandleHash.description: 0x-prefixed 32-byte keccak256 of the canonical `dwebHandle`. Provided so the client can verify the digest derivation.

nonce.description: Single-use server nonce, valid for this provisioning attempt only.

expiresAt.description: Unix epoch seconds; the nonce is rejected after this time.

chainId.description: Target chain id (Base mainnet 8453 or Base Sepolia 84532).

contractAddress.description: 0x-prefixed address of the deployed EtzhayyimAuthz contract on the target chain.

errors.name: DwebHandleInvalid
errors.description: dwebHandle is not a valid `<handle>.etzhayyim.com` form or contains disallowed characters.

errors.name: DwebHandleTaken
errors.description: dwebHandle is already bound to an existing active root.

errors.name: ActiveKeyInvalid
errors.description: activeKey is not a valid 20-byte 0x-prefixed Ethereum address.

errors.name: ConfigError
errors.description: etzhayyim authz backend is not configured for the requested chain.
